editorial: Today, the interaction between developer tools and artificial intelligence models is focusing particularly on embedding technologies and acceleration techniques in the field of video generation. Plugin structures on GitHub and next-generation data processing models on the Hugging Face platform point to a technical trend aimed at increasing system efficiency.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.summary: morluto/rea is a tool that uses artificial intelligence agents to analyze everything from application behaviors to native binaries through reverse engineering. Developed in the TypeScript language, this project aims to automate the process of analyzing complex software structures.

snapshot.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: claude-plugins-official, managed by Anthropic, is an official directory containing high-quality Claude Code plugins. Developed in Python, this repository brings together tools that users can utilize with Claude Code.

snapshot.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills is a library containing 177 verified skills and over 100 scientific databases that adapt artificial intelligence agents to scientific research processes. Working in fields such as biology, chemistry, and medicine, this tool is compatible with platforms like the Cursor code editor, AI-powered Claude Code, and similar.

snapshot.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: JuliusBrussee/caveman is a proxy and skill package that aims to reduce the amount of tokens used by coding artificial intelligence agents by 65 percent. The software aims to provide cost and resource savings by simplifying the outputs of AI models to speak like a caveman.

snapshot.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.summary: VoiceStudio is an open-source audio processing tool that performs operations such as voice cloning and video dubbing locally. Developed as an alternative to paid services like ElevenLabs, this software includes many features such as audiobook creation and transcription in 646 languages.

snapshot.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology developed for artificial intelligence agents. The project offers a structured method for creating and managing agent-based workflows.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

items.title: ruvnet/ruflo
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, ruflo is an agent infrastructure designed to coordinate autonomous workflows and create multiplayer artificial intelligence swarms. The system offers adaptive memory, self-learning capability, and vector-based RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) integration that allows data to be retrieved from up-to-date sources.

snapshot.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.summary: mksglu/context-mode is a TypeScript tool that optimizes the context window for artificial intelligence coding agents. By limiting tool outputs, it reduces memory usage and provides routing across seventeen different platforms via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

snapshot.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.

items.title: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
items.summary: Ghidra, developed by the National Security Agency (NSA), is a comprehensive framework used for software reverse engineering processes. Written in Java, this tool provides functions for understanding source code structure by analyzing binary files.

snapshot.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: affaan-m/ECC offers an infrastructure focused on skills, memory, and security to optimize the performance of artificial intelligence agents. It is a system developed for use on various platforms such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and the code editing tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

items.title: lightseekorg/tokenspeed
items.summary: lightseekorg/tokenspeed is a high-performance inference engine developed for large language models (LLM). Written in Python, this project aims to accelerate the prediction processes of artificial intelligence models.

snapshot.description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: Developed in the Rust language, xerj offers an auto-indexing capability that allows artificial intelligence systems to search through data. By processing code, documents, and log files with lower token consumption, it supports search, security audits, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) processes that enable AI to generate answers from up-to-date data.

snapshot.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.

items.title: LibreSpark/LibreTV
items.summary: LibreSpark/LibreTV is a TypeScript-based software project that allows you to set up a movie and TV series site in under a minute using methods like Docker. It provides an infrastructure that enables users to quickly create their own content platforms.

snapshot.description: 一分钟搭建影视站，支持Docker等部署方式

items.title: Muse Spark Open
items.summary: Muse Spark Open, released by Meta, stands out as an open-source artificial intelligence model aimed at researchers and developers. Accessible via Hugging Face, this model aims to make large-scale language processing capabilities more accessible.

snapshot.description: https://dev.meta.ai/resources/blog/build-with-muse-spark-ope...https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42Bhttps://9to5mac.com/2026/10/15/meta-launches-new-muse-spark-...

items.title: Neural networks are clean
items.summary: Neural networks are clean is a project that aims to visualize the internal working principles and conceptual structures of artificial intelligence models. This platform presents how complex neural networks make decisions based on specific data in an understandable way.

snapshot.description: https://twitter.com/nickcammarata/status/2110757819427574056

items.title: Wayland desktop for Linux with skeuomorphic design
items.summary: Developed for Linux, DEsk is a desktop environment that runs on the Wayland display server and features a skeuomorphic design based on realistic object appearances. The project aims to revive traditional interface aesthetics on modern Linux systems.

items.title: What I self-host
items.summary: What I self-host is an experience-sharing project about hosting personal data and digital services on individual servers instead of third-party platforms. It covers how a user manages their own infrastructure to achieve digital independence and the software tools they prefer.

items.title: Jev meets the Trolley Problem
items.summary: Jev combines artificial intelligence decision-making mechanisms with the Trolley Problem, a classic thought experiment that examines ethical dilemmas. This study questions how autonomous systems behave when faced with moral choices.

items.title: google/embeddinggemma-2
items.summary: Developed by Google, embeddinggemma-2 is a feature extraction model that converts text into numerical vectors. Available on the Hugging Face platform, this model is used to make sense of data in artificial intelligence applications.

snapshot.description: feature-extraction model

items.title: jialinyyzz/humanizer
items.summary: jialinyyzz/humanizer, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model that performs text generation. This model, which users can choose for text creation processes, has a popularity score of 1776 on the platform.

snapshot.description: text-generation model

items.title: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo
items.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model with text-to-image generation capabilities. It offers users the ability to produce visual content through written prompts.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model

items.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B
items.summary: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model that processes visual and text data to produce text output. This model offers the ability to analyze images and generate text-based responses.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model

items.title: fishaudio/drama-3
items.summary: fishaudio/drama-3, shared on Hugging Face, is a text-to-speech model that converts text into speech. It provides technology that allows users to turn written content into audio output.

snapshot.description: text-to-speech model

items.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
items.summary: FDE-Gym, offered by Hugging Face, is a benchmark tool that evaluates AI agents based on uncertain requirements and complex constraints in real-world delivery processes. With 95 end-to-end tasks based on real project scenarios from eighteen different sectors, it aims to measure the performance of agents in live systems.

snapshot.description: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated cu

items.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: ForcingBooster introduces a method that adapts computational power according to the complexity of image content in autoregressive video diffusion models. This approach aims to accelerate the video generation process by optimizing denoising operations in static or simple regions.

snapshot.description: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. items.title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
items.summary: Data World, shared by Hugging Face, is a multi-agent engine developed to overcome environmental constraints and validation challenges in the training process of data agents. The system synthesizes analysis processes and tasks through mechanisms by defining the world underlying these files before creating them.

snapshot.description: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. items.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
items.summary: OmniVerifier-C1, published on Hugging Face, is a model developed for the verification of complex visual content. Unlike traditional binary judgments, it acts as an AI visual verifier that offers more detailed and continuous scoring by breaking down complex rules.

snapshot.description: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique

items.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
items.summary: MAI-Gym is an open-source platform developed for the evaluation, data collection, and reinforcement learning training of graphical user interface (GUI) agents in mobile, computer, and web environments. It aims to solve challenges such as the cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic tasks by consolidating them through a common pipeline.

snapshot.description: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. glossary.explanation: Compiled machine code files that can be executed directly by a computer's processor.
The process of reverse-engineering the code or structure of a software to understand how it works.
Small program fragments added to extend the existing features of a software or to provide it with new functionalities.
A set of specialized commands or capabilities that enable AI agents to perform specific tasks.
The smallest unit of data, corresponding to words or character fragments, used by AI models when processing text.
Intermediate software that acts as a bridge between the user and the internet or another server to manage traffic.
Software infrastructure used to develop the capabilities of AI agents in a regular and systematic manner.
A group of multiple AI agents that collaborate by communicating with each other to solve complex tasks.
A method that enables AI to provide more accurate information by scanning and using up-to-date external data while generating answers.
The limit on the amount of text or data that an AI can process and hold in its memory at one time.
A protocol that allows AI models to communicate with different data sources and tools in a standardized way.
The United States government agency responsible for signals intelligence and cybersecurity.
The process of analyzing and deconstructing the operating logic and internal structure of software without needing its source code.
AI models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of a trained AI model generating predictions or results using new data provided to it.
A structured indexing system automatically created by the system to allow for rapid data retrieval.
